Atharv observed differences in parrot and sparrow beaks.
They described duck webbed feet and eagle talons.

end.parentNote: Atharv practised observing beaks and feet and linking these features to feeding and movement. They used examples such as a curved parrot beak, duck webbed feet, eagle talons, and long toes for gripping branches. They mixed up describing a fish-eating bird’s features at first, but later connected its pointy beak with catching fish and webbed feet with swimming. At home, look at two bird pictures together and ask Atharv to name one feature and explain what it helps the bird do.
